steps.content: On the game room screen, pixelated characters lose control and fall off cliffs, the black "game over" flashing continuously. Ice cream on the dining table melts into a white puddle, and even the colorful comic books gradually turn into line sketches until they become blank pages.
Seeing these changes, L.L. can't continue to trace the unknown intruder. She runs to the beach, trying to save these changing scenes.
But the sound of crystal shattering is heard, and the rose garden beside her turns from swaying roses to dark red crystals, then rapidly fades and shatters into powder.

L.L. collapses, her fingers touch a white conch buried in the sand. She picks it up like a treasure, clutching it in her hand. However, the next second, the conch also weathers into white sand, falling from L.L.'s fingers with the sea current.
The seabed storm stirs up white powder formed by death, bringing a blizzard to Elysiland.
She stares blankly at her hands, weakly tightening them for a moment.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: This is... the conch that the radio host likes the most... The conch allows her to hear her favorite sound.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: And that rose garden, without the roses, will that girl never see her father again?
L.L. stands up, slowly walks to the center of Elysiland, her footprints getting lost in all kinds of chaotic marks.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: This house is made of gold, and the owner can experience the joy of endless wealth.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Turning those who once bullied him into his furniture, that person loves this feeling of power the most.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: And these... the joy of sports and fitness, the joy of lying down and eating, the joy of daily parties and gambling, the joy of indulgence and wantonness...

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: They brought me all those things I had never seen or experienced before!

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: They can't find satisfaction in the outside world, so I help them achieve everything here. I said as long as they don't want to leave, no one can take away their right to enjoy.
She looks at the empty island.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: But they still left...

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: They clearly liked it here, they couldn't enjoy this kind of happiness anywhere else, so joyous, so free... but in the end, they left just like that...
L.L. props herself up under the huge billboard, looking at the now desolate island.
The tiny digital particles slowly gather into a small electronic pet, appearing beside L.L. with a sad face. It gently pats the girl with its fin, expressing its comfort.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: I don't blame you, Manty.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: That man in the grey coat is really cunning, it's not your fault you couldn't find him.
steps.female_content: That woman in the grey coat is really cunning, it's not your fault you couldn't find her.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Well... after all, it's just shallow pleasure and illusory experiences. Staying too long is harmful to the body. It was supposed to be a one-day tour, it was already overtime, they were almost addicted.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: They have to wake up... that's what normal people do.

The billboard in the center of the island is exactly where the sunlight from the sea surface illuminates. The photo on it once had many people surrounding L.L., like the group photos girls often take at parties, close together, everyone smiling happily.
But now it looks a bit different, once smiles become the past, they only make people feel lonely.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Ah... but I really don't want them to go!
She covers her face, finally letting it all out.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: What did he do? How can he make people let go of their happiness and return to such a boring reality?
steps.female_content: What did she do? How can she make people let go of their happiness and return to such a boring reality?

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Just by calling their names? By saying everything is fake, and staying longer is dangerous? By telling them to wake up?

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Tell me, what exactly did you do?
L.L. lowers her hand and looks back. Not far away, a gray figure quietly walks towards her.
He walks along the footprints left by L.L., letting the seabed storm lift his trench coat.
steps.female_content: She walks along the footprints left by L.L., letting the seabed storm lift her trench coat.

steps.content: His expression is the same as the first time L.L. saw him on the sea surface, serious and earnest, completely different from the atmosphere of this island.
steps.female_content: Her expression is the same as the first time L.L. saw her on the sea surface, serious and earnest, completely different from the atmosphere of this island.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: There's no one else on the island, just you and me. Now, tell me the answer.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: How did you manage to pull so many pleasure addicts out of the water, making them leave my island?

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Answer me, Chief of MBCC.
L.L. reaches out her hand, demanding an answer, as if it's only natural that this person will satisfy her desire.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: I don't need to do anything.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What is provided here is just pure pleasure, the most superficial delight. No matter how much you increase the stimulation, indulgence can't fulfill all of a person's needs.
No one likes hardship, but in life, many people are willing to endure hard work to maintain and strive for some people and things. Those are their most precious things.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I just made them remember. The decision to leave was their own.
She listens intently, lowering her head in some dejection.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: ...The precious things they want to maintain even if it's hard...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: So that's it, that's the kind of happiness I didn't know existed in the outside world...
She lifts her head, suddenly enlightened.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Then you should've just told me that!

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: No matter what you want, Elysiland will provide it. I'll do it for you. Then you can easily hold onto these treasures without having to endure any hardship, isn't that amazing?

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Why didn't you say so?
At this moment, her somewhat confused and strange realization seems very sincere.
Indeed, if she could understand, she wouldn't have created such a dangerous place on her own.
The ocean currents surrounding you have subtle changes, it's the familiar feeling of a Mania storm. There's not much time, you still have important things to do.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You've got your answer, now it's my turn to ask.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Who helped you build this Mania forum?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Elysiland links countless people's mental networks through the dark web. Once a Mania outbreak occurs...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You say you want to make people happy, but you know that indulging in these fake pleasures will only completely destroy a person.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Our tech experts have tracked all your traces on the dark web. You don't have enough dark web skills to create such a large forum like Elysiland.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Someone is helping you, no... they're using you. They help you build this stage and promote it, just to use your power to trap people like this.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: If I'm not mistaken, this isn't the first, nor will it be the last Elysiland, right? You and those behind you plan to create more traps to spread Mania through the dark web in Eastside.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Is the Underground behind the dark web?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Where are they now? What do you and those Mania followers really want to do?

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: ...I don't know what the Underground is, nor what they think.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: I just want to invite people here, to see them enjoy themselves, and be happy.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The Mania on the island has long exceeded the limit. Keeping them here will only create Corruptors that are addicted to happiness!
A dead silence. Her ocean-like eyes stare straight at you, as if a whirlpool is forming between you and her.
After an unknown amount of time, she finally looks away.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: You're right... I know this is bad, the dark web has problems. The happiness it creates is fake, superficial, and harmful.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: No matter how addicted the guests are, they will never feel like they belong in Elysiland. They all have lives outside and things they cherish there. I understand this, and I told them so from the beginning.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: But everyone can't help themselves. They know they should leave but still look back; they know they should stop but still take another bite. Even the shallowest pleasure is still pleasure, and even the most clearheaded person will succumb. Who hasn't been addicted at some point?

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: I'm simply the same!
L.L. chuckles, her voice still soft but the innocence in her eyes long faded, replaced by growing madness.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: I know one day is the limit, so I set the rule, prepared the ship for departure, and told them they should leave. I knew what you were trying to do the moment I saw you, and I didn't deal with you because I knew you were right.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: But you saw it that day. So many people found their passion, and begged to stay and share their joy with me. How could I let go? This is what I've always dreamed of!

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: I'm different from you all; I'm not sensible at all. Once I'm addicted, I can't stop or control myself, so I sank the island. I'm the one who can't leave this happiness the most!

Your clothes rustle, and the buildings on the island shatter in pieces under L.L.'s frantic shouts. They turn into surging data, sweeping around all desires, surrounding the island, and even blocking the fake sunlight.
Unknown objects surge in the dark, eagerly awaiting a command to tear apart you who is trying to awaken happiness, to drag you into their game, and to melt you into this frenzied joy.
The shackles start to thrash wildly, warning you about the surging Mania that's ready to erupt at any moment.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The Mania here is reaching the critical point, and it will threaten you too. Leave, there's not one guest here, nothing left to feed your addiction.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Heh, you say there's no more guests on my island? That's not true...
With a wave of her hand, everything on Elysiland stops surging and starts to reassemble. In the deep sea, it looks like a cursed paradise.
The swirling data swallows the creatures in the dark, rapidly expanding before your eyes, turning into countless places, people, things you've seen, imagined, or even your imagined self.
She suddenly gets close to you, her eyes shining with fanaticism.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: ...You're still here, my last and most interesting guest.
